mainEntity.name: What equipment is essential for starting barbell training at a gym like Cave Training?

acceptedAnswer.text: To start barbell training effectively, essential equipment includes barbells of varying weights, weight plates, and a squat rack or power cage. For personal use, a comfortable pair of athletic shoes with stable soles is beneficial. At Cave Training, all necessary equipment is provided, and our facility is equipped with high-quality barbells, plates, and racks to support all levels of training.
